description: Every document a FARA registrant has filed with the Justice Department, newest first: date, type, foreign principal, and a link to the filed document. Pass registration (the registration number other tools return) or firm (the registrant name as filed, matched exactly). A name on several registrations returns the list to choose from; registrations are never merged.

firm.description: Registrant name as filed, e.g. "Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld LLP"

name: foreign_agent_filings
title: A foreign agent's FARA filing history
